collector.note: shakedown corpus (provisional): one repetition per request, no /tokenize ground truth, request bodies as the recorder serialised them (parsed JSON, not raw bytes), no engine image digest. recipe_file_sha256 is the file's hash at corpus compaction: the recorded run predates the four recipe fixes of 2026-10-07, whose renders are byte-identical (verified against the recorded prompts). The release corpus is re-recorded at RC0 with rcp_ndcg_vllm.observe and keyed by fingerprint.

non_determinism.note: measured across the corpus's repeated observations of one engine prompt (the recorder's two same-process requests share the pair prompts); one repetition per request, so a second repetition and an after-restart repeat remain for the RC0 corpus to measure

full_corpus.note: the shakedown recorder's node-local output (12 recipes, files hashed together)

sampling.rule: all exchanges of the recorder's fixed set (the whole shakedown corpus)
